services.name: AI discovery and recommendation research
services.description: Research into how AI systems interpret customer needs, find and represent businesses, and support recommendations. Observed results can identify changes worth testing; technical checks alone do not establish recommendation or commercial impact.

services.name: Human-AI systems research and product design
services.description: Research, design and engineering for human-AI interaction: how people set direction, provide context, review AI work and stay in control across interfaces, agents and tools.

services.name: MCP app and AI tool engineering
services.description: Focused Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools and AI-assisted services, designed around useful tasks, clear permissions and responsible data handling.

services.name: Complex software product engineering
services.description: Bespoke software design and engineering that keeps requirements, decisions, implementation, tests and evidence connected as products change.

research.name: Human-AI interaction and AI-mediated discovery
research.description: Studies how people express intent to AI systems, how systems gather and assess information, and how answers, recommendations and actions are shaped by evidence, tools and commercial interests.

research.name: Signal by SR3H
research.description: Records defined customer questions, complete AI answers, sources and test conditions to show when a business is absent, mentioned or recommended and compare like-for-like repeated tests.

products.name: Conchup
products.description: A software development workspace that keeps requirements, decisions, code and tests connected, so changes can be reviewed against what the product is meant to do.

freeAidoDiscoverabilityCheck.name: Signal Website Check
freeAidoDiscoverabilityCheck.purpose: Inspect whether a public business website exposes usable access and offer information, then prepare and summarise a sourced ten-question discovery check in a compatible AI client without making OpenAI API calls from the MCP.
checks: Public page reachability and crawl directives
An optional ten-question customer research pack that requires user agreement and makes no OpenAI API call
Sourced observations supplied by research tools available in the user's ChatGPT session
Clear separation between technical discoverability and commercial outcome evidence
doesNotProve: A fixed ChatGPT ranking, citation or recommendation
